title: Feridwyn
summary_html: Feridwyn is one of the operators of the Fellowship homeless shelter in Paws in Ultima VII. He runs the shelter with the aide of his wife, Brita, with whom he has a single son, Garritt. He also appears in Ultima Underworld II.
